incident-bot: ALERT: spike detected on route=embeddings-hot-route -> 5xx rate up 18x, p95 latency 4x normal. Auto-escalation to P1 if not mitigated in 10m

Jordan (oncall): seeing same in Grafana, looks shard-local to us-west-2 GPU pool. customers with high embed QPS affected. paging SREs.

Samantha L: tagging infra, could be KV cache pressure from large prefix reuse.

Liam K: @Jordan (oncall) can you snapshot the recent `requests_by_route` and `kv_cache_hit`?

Jordan (oncall): grabbing now. attaching quick grep output: ```
route embeddings-hot-route : qps 12k -> 60k
kv_cache_hit_rate: 11% -> 2%
error_codes: 503: 312, 500: 9
```

Maria - Support: heads-up, two enterprise tenants reported degraded embeddings. CS notified customers on degraded ingest.

Kevin I: can we do a surgical per-endpoint tweak? Proposal: carve embeddings-hot-route down to 5k qps for public tenants, reserve 1k qps for enterprise slices, and bump chat fallback route for affected tenants. Also disable `rerank` on that route to reduce model load.

Oncall SRE: agree. Plan: 1) throttle embeddings-hot-route globally to 5k qps 2) set per-tenant qps for known customers 3) disable rerank flag on that route 4) monitor 5xx and latency for 10m -> rollback if worse.

Jordan (oncall): executing now. commands: ```bash
# throttle embeddings route
adminctl set-quota --route embeddings-hot-route --qps 5000 --scope global
# reserve enterprise slices
adminctl set-tenant-quota --tenant-id T-ACME --route embeddings-hot-route --qps 1000
# disable rerank for route
feature-flags disable rerank --route embeddings-hot-route
```

Samantha L: please add a temporary traffic-shape to route rerouting so high QPS customers fallback to `chat-micro` embeddings (lower res) instead of overloading GPU pool.

Liam K: added a route-sculpt rule: ```json
{"match": "tenant in [T-ACME, T-BETA]", "fallback_route": "embeddings-lowcost", "max_qps": 800}
``` (deployed)

Jordan (oncall): changes applied. immediate drop in 5xx: 503 down from 312 -> 28 in the last 2m. p95 latency trending down.

Maria - Support: confirmed with CS that ACME latency improved, they accept temporary reduced throughput. Communicated ETA for full recovery ~30m.

Kevin I: leaving rerank disabled for 30m, we'll review resource pressure and redispatch capacity. Also launching a small canary of a quantized variant on one host to see if we can restore capacity.

Oncall SRE: monitoring dashboard set to 1m and alert thresholds tightened. If errors remain above 15m we'll promote to P1 and call exec.

Jordan (oncall): logging mitigation steps in incident tracker and will create a follow-up runbook for per-route quota surgery.

Samantha L: quick postmortem notes: root cause suspected: sudden burst from customer-side batch re-ingest + cache eviction after model warming. Suggested follow-ups: better per-tenant qos, auto carve logic, and KV cache size tuning.

Liam K: +1. Will file infra PR for auto-carve heuristics (thresholds, cool-down windows).

Maria - Support: I'll coordinate customer comms and offer temporary credits where needed.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> reduced errors, route throttles active. Incident status -> MONITORING. Create postmortem within 72h. :white_check_mark:
